intent.raw: Refresh all necessary FPR-02B backend test-engine and downstream consumer-proof artifacts after the accepted 16-decision gate.
intent.objective: Apply the approved, evidence-linked refresh package that synchronizes the stale BTE plan with independent edges, IOLM proof, Body War read-only consumer proof, integrated manifest, Craft pointers, and inventory follow-up without executing or promoting anything.
intent.operator_sentence: Refresh all necessary artifacts while keeping UI and backend lanes independent and preserving DomainSpec authority.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The refresh is bounded and sequential; no delegated subagent route is needed.

boundaries.contract: Inventory provides discovery handles only; current owner artifacts are verified before status claims are made.
The accepted decision supplies resolved choices but does not authorize schema, profile, consumer, Craft, or runtime mutation.
Consumers import explicit graph/profile/obligation/receipt handles and retain candidate/authoritative posture; they cannot define upstream authority.
The explicit user approval permits only the declared BTE/IOLM/consumer/Craft/inventory synchronization targets; implementation, execution, and production remain outside scope.

authority.evidence: FPR decision, BTE/IOLM/Body War contracts, Craft and Inventory handles
authority.promotion: DomainSpec v2, IOLM, Body War, Craft, and release owners remain separate

state_namespaces.owner: DomainSpec, IOLM, Body War, Craft, Inventory

state_namespaces.write_policy: write only inside this dated refresh folder
write only the declared apply-approved synchronization targets
write only the declared read-only consumer contracts and manifest

promotion_splits.source: candidate BTE graph, obligation, and consumer proof
promotion_splits.target: profile admission, FPR closure, production, public Arcanum, or semantic promotion
promotion_splits.rule: Evidence informs owner decisions but cannot promote itself or waive an independent gate.

steps.name: Resolve target artifacts and repository inventory handles

capability_metadata.scope: repository-local index lookup followed by owner-receipt verification

stop_conditions: block if inventory is treated as promotion authority
flag partial source coverage without silently backfilling

steps.name: Build strict refresh context from accepted decision and target evidence
stop_conditions: block if an obligation lacks selected evidence
block if authority and candidate posture collapse

steps.name: Apply approved typed refresh signals within the declared mutation boundary
stop_conditions: block on any undeclared target mutation
block if a delta lacks a typed RefreshSignal
block if implementation, execution, or production work is attempted

steps.name: Validate refresh package and route boundaries
stop_conditions: block on dispatch schema or technique errors
flag target application as pending approval

gates.condition: Source evidence, target root, evidence date, strict context, and apply-approved mode are explicit.
Only the declared BTE, IOLM, Body War consumer, integrated manifest, Craft, inventory, and dated receipt surfaces are written; engine execution and production remain unchanged.
Consumer proof must not become canonical knowledge, define O_spec, admit a profile, close FPR, or authorize production.
Dispatch schema and technique trace validate; residue is retained in the report.
Explicit user approval `apply approved` is recorded in refresh-report.json; no Task Session or SWU is selected by this refresh.

promotion_guardrails: No production or public release claim.
No BTE implementation or consumer code execution.
No Craft semantic authority or inventory promotion.
No merge/copy of legacy and v2 engine paths.
